commands.label: Toggle line comment
commands.description: Comments out the line under the cursor, or uncomments it when it is a comment.
examples: gcc, on let x = 1 → the line reads // let x = 1
commands.rationale: Vim commentary and Neovim use gcc to toggle a line comment; c for comment.

commands.label: Show documentation
commands.description: Shows the documentation of the symbol under the cursor in a popup.
examples: K, on parseArgs → the documentation of parseArgs opens
commands.rationale: Vim and Neovim use K to look up the word under the cursor.

semantics.ideavim: IdeaVim runs K as Quick Documentation.

deviation.shadows: Vim K, which runs keywordprg on the word under the cursor
deviation.note: VS Code shows the hover instead of running keywordprg.
